scientific_question: Can temporal separation of equal integrated top inflow and bottom outflow produce strict accepted 16-node origins with the same total profile water and same upper-30-cm water as a baseline, but materially different deeper vertical distribution?
derivation: E03 showed that simultaneous equal top/bottom throughflow recovers upper-30-cm storage and M1 along an almost coincident trajectory.
A stronger simultaneous recovery flux would mainly traverse the same coupled state path faster and is therefore not the preferred next discriminator.
Separating top refill from bottom drainage preserves the complete-family mass ledger while giving the upper and lower profile distinct forcing phases.

time_and_flux_design.complete_family_integral: For each n, integrated top flux equals integrated bottom flux exactly: n*q_eq*dt on both boundaries; the preceding closed phase contributes zero.

execution_contract: each BASE or split family starts from the same fresh B01 Se=0.85 physical origin
each split family first executes exactly 10 strict CLOSED intervals with q_top=q_bottom=0
the two split phases then execute exactly n intervals each in the preregistered order
only a family completing both split phases contributes a candidate endpoint
every interval uses one strict Reference physical advance with no automatic temporal subdivision, fallback or tolerance relaxation
failed intervals terminate that family and leave the latest committed origin bit-identical
candidate output contains only history provenance plus committed H/theta state; no interface response quantity is emitted

response_blind_selection.candidate_set: BASE_EQ endpoint plus every completed split-family endpoint
response_blind_selection.pair_set: all distinct-history pairs in the candidate set
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E03B NO_MATCH without changing n-grid, order set, flux magnitude, dt or thresholds.

qualification_gates: complete candidate families contain only strict mass-complete commits
failed family is transaction-safe and excluded from candidate selection
selector parses no response, exchange, terminal-flux or tangent fields
selected pair, if any, is persisted with all 16 H/theta values before any response experiment
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E04 preregisters common-time reconstruction of the immutable E03B pair and an identical forcing-free fixed-Hc response probe with both W_profile and W_root30 gates enforced.
controls: unchanged W_profile, W_root30 and M1 thresholds
no HELD_OUT or FALLBACK state access
no production source or coupling API changes
nonclaims: E03B selection alone does not establish deeper-profile response memory
split boundary forcing is a research state-construction device, not an admitted production operating mode
no second MODFLOW hydraulic state is introduced
